content: New polling commissioned by Fox News shows Texas Democrat James Talarico narrowly ahead of the state’s Trump-backed Republican attorney general, Ken Paxton, in their contest for a seat in the US Senate. According to the survey, Talarico leads Paxton by three percentage points, 51% to 48%, among registered voters, which is within the poll’s margin of error. The same survey shows an even tighter race for Texas governor, with the Republican incumbent, Greg Abbott, just one point ahead of his Democratic challenger, state lawmaker Gina Hinojosa, 50% to 49%. The polling also suggests that Donald Trump’s unpopularity might be a drag on the Republicans he supports. The president is viewed unfavorably by 54% of Texas voters, which is worse than Paxton (51%), Abbott (49%), Talarico (43%) and Hinojosa (34%). Writing on social media, Donald Trump claimed that his so-called “Board of Peace” reached an agreement on Thursday for the complete ⁠disarmament of Hamas militants and other armed groups in Gaza. “The agreement will be carried out in carefully structured phases,” the president wrote. “As disarmament is completed, Israeli forces will withdraw, and the International Stabilization Force will work with a new Palestinian police force to take responsibility for Gaza being safe for its residents and its neighbors.” Trump thanked Egyptian, Qatari and Turkish mediators, and his own “outstanding team” for what he called “a critical step towards Gaza finally being governed by a ‌new Palestinian government that will work closely with the Board of Peace”. “At the same time, Israel will have the security it deserves, with Gaza no longer used as a base for terror attacks,” he added. Earlier in the day, sources told Reuters that talks between mediators ⁠and Hamas leaders in Cairo on implementing a US-brokered Gaza peace plan had made rare progress, although an Israeli official said proposed terms were ‌not satisfactory. “One year ago there was a violent raging war” in Gaza, Trump said. “We have made historic progress.” He made no mention of the ongoing Israeli attacks on the Palestinian enclave. Israeli strikes killed at least six Palestinians in Gaza on Thursday, including two children, medics said. Last week, the United Nations Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs reported that 1,180 Palestinians had been killed, and 3,810 wounded, since Trump announced the Gaza ceasefire agreement between Israel and Hamas on 9 October 2025. The House Democratic Women’s Caucus called on Thursday for an ethics committee investigation of congressman Max Miller, an Ohio Republican and former Trump aide who has been accused of domestic abuse by his ex-wife and former girlfriend. The group’s chair, Teresa Leger Fernández of New Mexico, and vice-chairs, Emilia Sykes of Ohio and Hillary Scholten of Michigan, said in a statement: The recent reports of domestic violence and child abuse against Representative Max Miller are deeply disturbing and Congress can’t ignore them. Allegations of violence against women and children have to be met with the utmost seriousness. We therefore call on the House Committee on Ethics to swiftly and thoroughly investigate these allegations. Every woman and child deserves to live free from fear of violence, especially within the sanctity of their own home, and we will not stop fighting until that’s the reality. The Republican congressman, 37, who represents Ohio’s seventh congressional district, has denied accusations made by his ex-wife, Emily Moreno, and former girlfriend Stephanie Grisham, as he campaigns for re-election. Moreno, a conservative policy adviser whose father is Ohio senator Bernie Moreno, shares a two-year-old daughter with Miller. The pair have been engaged in a legal battle over custody of their child since 2024. Grisham, who held the roles of press secretary for both Donald Trump and Melania Trump at various points during Trump’s first term, dated Miller from 2019 to 2020, when he was a White House staffer. A former White House counsel and former general counsel of Goldman Sachs, who has faced scrutiny over her past ties to Jeffrey Epstein, told a House committee this month that some of the allegations made by one his most prominent accusers “lacked inherent credibility”, according to newly released transcripts. Kathryn Ruemmler’s name appeared thousands of times in records related to Epstein, the disgraced financier and convicted sex offender, that were released earlier this year by the US Department of Justice under the Epstein Files Transparency Act. The files revealed Ruemmler had accepted gifts from Epstein, who died by suicide while awaiting trial in 2019 after he was arrested by federal authorities, at times addressed him as “Uncle Jeffrey” and “sweetie” in emails, and offered him informal advice on how to respond to questions about his sex crimes. Ruemmler’s testimony before Congress when she was asked about Virginia Giuffre, a victim of Epstein’s abuse, was swiftly criticized by Giuffre’s family. “She should be ashamed of herself,” Giuffre’s brother and sister-in-law, Sky and Amanda Roberts, said in a statement. Giuffre died by suicide in April 2025. Two federal appeals courts ruled on Thursday that the Trump administration cannot deny immigrants detained inside the United States a chance for release on bond, rejecting a new policy to detain even undocumented immigrants with no criminal records who have resided in the US for years. In a pair of 2-1 decisions, majorities of the San Francisco-based 9th US circuit court of appeals and the Chicago-based 7th US circuit court of appeals agreed with four previous appeals court rulings across the country that a 1996 law does not mandate the detention of every undocumented immigrant who initially entered the country unlawfully, no matter how long ago. chineseSummary: 共和党参议员苏珊·柯林斯、丽莎·穆尔科斯基和兰德·保罗投票赞成阻止特朗普继续对伊朗采取敌对行动的动议
chineseContent: 福克斯新闻委托进行的最新民意调查显示，在争夺美国参议院席位的竞争中，得克萨斯州民主党人詹姆斯·塔拉里科以微弱优势领先于该州特朗普支持的共和党总检察长肯·帕克斯顿。调查显示，在登记选民中，塔拉里科领先帕克斯顿三个百分点，即 51% 比 48%，这在民意调查的误差范围内。同一项调查显示，德克萨斯州州长的竞争更加激烈，共和党现任州长格雷格·阿博特 (Greg Abbott) 仅以 50% 比 49% 的优势领先民主党挑战者、州议员吉娜·伊诺霍萨 (Gina Hinojosa) 一分。民意调查还表明，唐纳德·特朗普的不受欢迎可能会拖累他支持的共和党人。 54%的德克萨斯州选民对总统持负面看法，这一比例比帕克斯顿（51%）、阿博特（49%）、塔拉里科（43%）和伊诺霍萨（34%）还要差。唐纳德·特朗普在社交媒体上写道，他所谓的“和平委员会”周四达成了一项协议，彻底解除哈马斯武装分子和加沙其他武装团体的武装。 “该协议将分阶段进行，”总统写道。 “随着解除武装的完成，以色列军队将撤出，国际稳定部队将与新的巴勒斯坦警察部队合作，为加沙居民和邻国的安全承担责任。”特朗普感谢埃及、卡塔尔和土耳其的调解员以及他自己的“杰出团队”，他称之为“加沙最终由新的巴勒斯坦政府管理的关键一步，该政府将与和平委员会密切合作”。他补充说：“与此同时，以色列将获得应有的安全，加沙不再被用作恐怖袭击的基地。”当天早些时候，消息人士告诉路透社，调解员与哈马斯领导人在开罗就实施
